decisions.reason: Building on the established offer and with a dedicated webpage, the medical examination light has sunk investments and public commitment, but its narrower medical niche makes withdrawal somewhat more likely than core industrial lines.
As a multi-model product line central to the firm's industrial lighting business with high sunk investment and strong public visibility, escalation of commitment makes dropping very unlikely.
Close to the established offer and relaunched as a popular product with high visibility, the designer task light benefits from strong escalation effects, keeping the withdrawal probability low.

Although close to the established office lighting segment, the pendant office luminaire is a single model with lower accumulated investment and visibility, so escalation favors persistence but less strongly.
As a multi-model premium line close to the core offer with high sunk investment and visibility, the premium pendant luminaire has strong escalation commitment, making withdrawal unlikely.
